purpose: Publish and inspect only the BP inherit, BP override and neutral Employee-disabled notification samples through normal authenticated authoring and signed publication APIs.
constraints: Existing MFA and independent-review checks remain enforced.

The existing permission catalog supports tenant-level authoring grants, not draft-level grants; the grants temporarily authorize these operations across this tenant. The verification script uses only its sample drafts.
No Neon permission or role changes are needed: Studio publication inspection reads the tenant-scoped verified Neon projection.
No direct writes to notification policies, templates, publication snapshots or activation heads.
No email, SMS, WhatsApp or push delivery.
